overview.title: System overview: separate, connected workflows
overview.purpose: Use this map to locate the independent workflow files. It does not replace any detailed end-to-end process.
overview.trigger: Choose the journey you need to explain.
rules: The six groups are independent entry points, not a mandatory sequence of unrelated tasks.
Use the index to open an individual workflow. Customer and operator actions are separated by responsibility.
External email, payment, push and courier services are shown only in the workflows that use them.
groups: Purchase, payment, fulfillment, returns and refunds
Product reviews, FMRC replies and inquiries
Inventory, products, reports, notifications and archives
Content, branding, policies and operating settings

workflows.title: Customer registration and sign-in
workflows.purpose: Create a Customer account or sign in through the available password or Google path.
workflows.trigger: A visitor wants an authenticated Customer session.

steps.label: Verify Google or challenge, if used

rules: New public registration creates Customer accounts, never Admin or Staff accounts.
Google sign-in and CAPTCHA depend on configured keys. Failed login and lockout do not grant access.
Forgotten passwords follow F04; sessions and sign-out follow F07.

workflows.title: Staff account application and approval
workflows.purpose: An applicant requests Staff access; an Admin reviews and approves or declines the application.
workflows.trigger: A prospective Staff member opens the account-request form.
rules: Application alone does not create an active Staff session.
Admin approval rechecks identifiers; a username or Gmail taken after submission blocks creation.
Requests are subject to CAPTCHA, rate limits and installed storage.

workflows.title: Admin user management
workflows.purpose: An Admin creates separate user accounts or deletes eligible accounts through User Management.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens User Management.

steps.label: Enter user details or select account

rules: Only full Admin accounts manage users. A new Admin has separate credentials and personal settings.
The built-in Admin, signed-in account and last full Admin are protected by current safeguards.
Deletion eligibility and retained history are enforced by the server; direct requests cannot bypass them.

workflows.title: Password reset
workflows.purpose: Recover account access using the existing emailed one-time-code flow.
workflows.trigger: An account holder chooses Forgot password.

branches.label: Correct code or request a new one

rules: Code expiry, retry limits and throttling remain authoritative; invalid attempts do not reset a password.
An Admin unable to receive email may use an existing unused recovery code through F06.
Email delivery depends on the configured mail service.

workflows.title: Personal profile and credential updates
workflows.purpose: Each signed-in person updates only the profile and sign-in fields their portal permits.
workflows.trigger: A signed-in user opens personal account details.
rules: Customer, Staff and Admin use separate account entry points. Only their own permitted fields can change.
Admin Gmail changes use emailed verification when its storage is installed. Staff and Customer use their existing update path.
Password changes require the current password; unchanged forms cannot submit. Read-only Staff name stays protected.

workflows.title: Admin recovery-code generation and redemption
workflows.purpose: A full Admin generates one-time recovery codes and can later redeem one to recover access.
workflows.trigger: An Admin manages or needs existing recovery codes.

steps.label: Store codes or sign in securely

branches.label: Retry within limits; no access granted

rules: Generate: validate current password, invalidate the old set, then show the new codes once for offline storage.
Redeem: validate an unused code and new password, consume that code, reset the password and send an alert.
Recovery-code endpoints are Admin-only; Staff and Customer do not gain this path.

workflows.title: Session renewal, expiry and logout
workflows.purpose: Authenticated operators renew an eligible session or safely end access.
workflows.trigger: An operator signs in or a session reaches its warning window.

steps.label: Renew eligible session or revoke token

rules: Idle warning, renewal and absolute lifetime are distinct. An expired session cannot be renewed as an active one.
Logout confirmation cancellation preserves the session; confirmed logout revokes its access.
The diagram shows operator session controls. Customer token-based logout also ends the current device session.

workflows.title: Personal Settings and sidebar customization
workflows.purpose: Save account-specific appearance, display, branding and sidebar preferences.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Settings.
rules: Theme, reduced motion, table density and branding belong to the authenticated user, not every operator.
A logo editor Cancel leaves the saved logo unchanged; Use logo applies its prepared canvas.
Offline changes remain local with explicit sync feedback; Restore defaults keeps its immediate behavior.

workflows.title: Service consultation: booking to completion
workflows.purpose: Book and attend a consultation without automatically creating a custom-product order.
workflows.trigger: A visitor selects Book a consultation.

steps.label: Review; set online link if needed

rules: Online and face-to-face are meeting-method branches, not the two separate appointment business workflows.
Booking uses shared calendar availability and validation. Private file uploads require the permitted signed-in path.
A meeting link is not evidence that a consultation happened. Custom-product work is separately tracked in F10.

workflows.title: Custom-product appointment: request to fulfillment
workflows.purpose: Connect consultation, agreed specifications, quotation, full payment, production and fulfillment.
workflows.trigger: A signed-in Customer requests a custom product with a consultation.

branches.label: Clarify brief, follow up or close

rules: Only an attended, confirmed consultation may advance to quotation. More information, follow-up or decline are real alternatives.
Acceptance creates one linked Order; full online or advance-cash payment is required before production.
Expired or unpaid quotations may need renewal. Resolve prior orders, held money and refunds before re-quoting.

workflows.title: Appointment rescheduling and cancellation
workflows.purpose: Change an eligible consultation schedule or cancel it while keeping linked work protected.
workflows.trigger: A Customer opens an owned appointment.

steps.label: Select new slot or confirm cancel

rules: Rescheduling is restricted by the existing time and ownership rules; a stale schedule must be refreshed.
A slot change preserves the consultation identity and respects current availability.
Custom jobs, accepted orders and held payments use their own guards; cancelling a meeting is not an automatic refund.

workflows.title: Calendar availability management
workflows.purpose: Manage bookable dates, notes and time slots while protecting current appointments.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Manage Calendar.

steps.label: Edit blocks, notes or time slots

rules: Default schedules, day-specific changes and existing reservations are checked by current scheduling rules.
Calendar changes do not silently rebook existing Customers.
Both operator portals read the same shared calendar; personal Settings do not alter it.

workflows.title: Product purchase: browse to completion
workflows.purpose: Follow a normal product order through checkout, FMRC review, payment and fulfillment.
workflows.trigger: A Customer browses available products.

steps.label: Online: pay now. Cash: pay at pickup.

rules: FMRC request review comes before payment availability; approval reserves stock and is separate from starting preparation.
New normal orders support enabled online payment or cash on pickup. Delivery uses the eligible online-payment path.
Online payment: F14. Cash pickup and collection: F15. Delivery: F16. Legacy COD is not a new-order default.

workflows.title: Online payment and provider confirmation
workflows.purpose: Create an eligible checkout and confirm payment using verified provider evidence.
workflows.trigger: An approved normal order or accepted custom quotation is awaiting online payment.

steps.label: Follow fulfillment; do not pay twice

branches.label: Pending or failed: check status first

rules: Returning from checkout, a screenshot or a manually typed reference does not establish provider-managed payment.
Pending or uncertain attempts are checked before retry; duplicate or late payments require recorded review.
Cash on pickup bypasses hosted checkout. Custom advance cash follows F17 instead.

workflows.title: Pickup fulfillment and collection
workflows.purpose: Prepare an eligible pickup order and confirm physical collection using the Customer pickup code.
workflows.trigger: A pickup order is approved for preparation.

steps.label: Record cash if due; verify code

rules: Unresolved payment, cancellation, refund or custom-production holds prevent collection.
Custom orders must already have full payment and ready production; normal pickup cash is recorded at collection.
Delivery orders use F16 instead. A Customer cannot manually force completion through the retired receive action.

workflows.title: Delivery handover and courier tracking
workflows.purpose: Record genuine J&T handover, track the parcel and complete eligible delivery from verified courier evidence.
workflows.trigger: A paid order is ready for courier dispatch.

branches.label: Resolve setup; do not invent scans
In transit or exception: await review

rules: The current automatic tracking integration is 17TRACK for J&T; activation and provider credentials are configuration-dependent.
FMRC notes do not rewrite courier events. Exceptions, corrected waybills and unverified evidence need review.
The accepted shipping fee stays recorded; later actual courier charges do not silently change the Customer agreement.

workflows.title: Custom production and advance cash
workflows.purpose: Record full custom-order payment before starting production and then complete fulfillment.
workflows.trigger: A Customer accepts an eligible custom quotation.

steps.label: Read online receipt or record cash

rules: Online: provider confirmation (F14). Advance cash: record the full amount actually received at FMRC before production.
Only Admin may correct an eligible cash receipt or issue a custom cash refund; these are auditable separate actions.
Paid work is not silently rewritten. Close and reconcile the existing order before a new quotation.

workflows.title: Order cancellation
workflows.purpose: Cancel an eligible order directly or request an operator decision when required.
workflows.trigger: A Customer opens Cancel order.
rules: Eligible immediate cancellations bypass operator review. Other eligible requests wait for an explicit decision.
Cancellation and refund are separate outcomes. A paid order can be cancelled while its money still needs review (F22).
Paid cancellations require the applicable refund process; recording cancellation alone does not return money.

workflows.title: Order rejection
workflows.purpose: Decline an eligible order request or reject eligible unfulfilled work with a recorded reason.
workflows.trigger: An operator identifies an order that cannot be fulfilled.

steps.label: Queue refund review if money held

rules: Request review and later fulfillment rejection use their own current server safeguards.
A recorded rejection does not by itself certify that held money has been refunded.
Bulk decisions recheck each selected record; protected records are not forced through.

workflows.title: Refunded-order review
workflows.purpose: Resolve a normal active order whose payment has already been refunded before fulfillment.
workflows.trigger: An order displays Refunded - FMRC review required.
rules: Only eligible normal orders use this path; it is not a second refund or a replacement checkout.
Courier handover, collection, pending cancellation or incomplete refund evidence blocks closure.
Stock decisions respect any quantity already released; refresh stale records before confirming.

workflows.title: Returns and resolution
workflows.purpose: Review a Customer return, receive the item and apply the approved resolution.
workflows.trigger: A Customer requests help with a completed order.
rules: The current return window is seven days after completion; only one open return is allowed per order.
Online refunds follow F22 after the approved return is received and inspected; custom cash refunds require Admin authority.
Repair or replacement is recorded as a resolution; that label alone does not create automatic replacement fulfillment.

workflows.title: Online refund request, approval and retry
workflows.purpose: Request an eligible refund, obtain Admin authorization and confirm its actual provider result.
workflows.trigger: A closed order, approved return or verified extra payment needs a refund.

steps.label: Process refund and QR Ph claim

branches.label: Check status; review retry or rejection

rules: Staff can request a refund; issuing, approval and rejection follow Admin-only authority.
A confirmed receipt and remaining refundable amount are required. Requested or processing is not Refund confirmed.
Check failed/unknown attempts before retry. QR Ph completion depends on the provider claim and funded merchant wallet.

workflows.title: Walk-in sales
workflows.purpose: Record a walk-in transaction and its existing cashier-based payment information.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Add Walk-in.

steps.label: Select item, cost and cashier record

rules: Walk-in payment is recorded as WALKIN VIA CASHIER, not as hosted checkout.
A linked product quantity updates product stock through the existing transaction behavior.
Completion and archiving preserve their existing eligibility and reporting rules.

workflows.title: Product reviews and FMRC replies
workflows.purpose: Publish an eligible Customer product review and allow operators to respond or archive it.
workflows.trigger: A Customer opens the review action for an order.

steps.label: Browse reviews or like a review

rules: Order ownership and review eligibility are checked server-side; a public visitor cannot impersonate a purchaser.
Replying and archiving are operator actions; Customer likes and public visibility follow existing rules.
Archiving is distinct from editing a Customer rating or changing a product purchase.

workflows.title: Customer inquiry submission and resolution
workflows.purpose: Send a signed-in Customer inquiry and track the operator read/resolution process.
workflows.trigger: A Customer opens the Contact inquiry form.
rules: Submitting an inquiry requires the existing signed-in Customer path.
The inquiry module records read and resolved states; it does not include an in-app conversation thread.
Delete actions require explicit confirmation and existing permissions.

workflows.title: Inventory items and variants
workflows.purpose: Create or edit inventory records while preserving variant-level stock ownership.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Add or Edit Item.
rules: Variant stock is tracked separately; mixed units must not be shown as one misleading combined quantity.
Editing identity fields does not bypass read-only stock controls; adjustments use F27.
Failed saves retain entered values; archiving uses the existing confirmation flow.

workflows.title: Inventory stock adjustments
workflows.purpose: Add or deduct an allowed quantity for an inventory item or a selected variant.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Adjust Stocks.

steps.label: Choose add or deduct; enter amount

rules: A positive amount and existing stock rules govern adjustments; missing data is not treated as zero.
Select the actual variant when stock is variant-owned.
An inventory adjustment is not automatically a product catalog purchase or an online payment.

workflows.title: Low-stock rules
workflows.purpose: Set fixed or percentage thresholds with the existing override inheritance order.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Stock Level Rules.
rules: Precedence is variant, item, category, then default. Empty overrides inherit the next applicable rule.
Fixed and percentage thresholds retain their existing calculations; zero stock remains Out of Stock.
Background refresh does not overwrite an actively edited draft.

workflows.title: Product catalog and media management
workflows.purpose: Manage products, prices, stock, visibility and gallery media for the public catalog.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Products.
rules: Checked visibility controls retain their existing is_blocked meaning; labels must not imply an inverted value.
Gallery slots, upload limits, cover assignment and draft recovery are preserved.
Permanent deletion remains guarded by server restrictions and explicit confirmation.

workflows.title: Promotions management
workflows.purpose: Create, update and retire promotions while preserving public eligibility and timing.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Promotions.

steps.label: Edit, archive or delete as allowed

rules: The active-public query, dates and product eligibility decide what Customers see.
Promotion changes do not rewrite accepted historical order totals.
Failed saves preserve drafts; destructive actions require existing confirmations.

workflows.title: Announcements management
workflows.purpose: Publish and manage Customer-facing announcements using the existing promotion-page editor.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Add or Edit Announcement.
rules: Public visibility follows the current announcement endpoint and saved settings.
Announcements communicate information; they do not approve appointments, orders or payments.
Archive and delete actions remain distinct and explicitly confirmed.

workflows.title: Reports, letterhead and printing
workflows.purpose: Generate a report from existing shared records and prepare an official print/PDF output.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Reports.

branches.label: Review empty results or load error

rules: Reports derive totals from orders, payments, walk-in sales and refunds; generating a report does not mutate revenue.
Inventory and Product Stock categories retain their existing period and data rules.
Letterhead settings and print layout are shared; previews do not submit new transactions.

workflows.title: Notifications and personal feed state
workflows.purpose: Distribute eligible system events while keeping operator read and dismissal state personal.
workflows.trigger: An event creates an eligible notification.
rules: Admin/Staff read and dismissal timestamps are personal; one operator does not clear another feed.
Staff cannot view Admin-only notification types. Missing notification-state setup is an error, not shared-state fallback.
Customer and operator feeds are separate. Email, in-app and optional push channels are not transaction evidence.

workflows.title: Archives, restoration and permanent cleanup
workflows.purpose: Move eligible records into Archives, restore them or permanently delete only permitted records.
workflows.trigger: An operator selects an archive or cleanup action.
rules: Active work, pending cancellations and unresolved money can block archive actions.
Online refunds and cancellation history retain restore-only protection and are excluded from automatic deletion.
Automatic retention uses the existing eligible modules and saved period; permanent deletion is not the same as archive.

workflows.title: Home content management
workflows.purpose: Edit shared Home content while preserving the existing preview, validation and save behavior.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Home Page Management.
rules: Hero, fabrication scene, brand logos, SDGs, service cards and section text retain existing bindings.
Image adjustment prepares a draft; Save All Changes remains the publication boundary for draft-managed content.
Operator changes are shared content, distinct from personal sidebar branding.

workflows.title: About Us content management
workflows.purpose: Edit shared About Us content while preserving the existing preview, validation and save behavior.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens About Us Page Management.
rules: University name, Vision and Mission keep all editable fields, plain text and paragraph breaks.
A missing Vision or Mission keeps the Customer university section hidden; loading does not display stale content.
Gallery and video operations retain validation, draft cleanup and save/readback behavior.

workflows.title: Services content management
workflows.purpose: Edit shared Services content while preserving the existing preview, validation and save behavior.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Services Page Management.
rules: Service cards and categories retain their existing add, edit and delete controls and permissions.
Custom-product request availability depends on the service eligibility flag and installed custom-product feature.
Deleting a service or category does not bypass retained-record checks.

workflows.title: Contact content management
workflows.purpose: Edit shared Contact content while preserving the existing preview, validation and save behavior.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Contact Page Management.
rules: Contact details and section copy use existing limits and save/readback behavior.
Editing the Contact page is separate from resolving submitted Customer inquiries in F25.
Failed saves keep field entries; public readers see saved shared content.

workflows.title: Footer content management
workflows.purpose: Edit shared Footer content while preserving the existing preview, validation and save behavior.
workflows.trigger: An operator opens Footer Page Management.
rules: Footer text, contact details and links keep their existing fields and validation.
Shared footer changes affect their existing Customer page consumers, not operator personal preferences.
Failed saves retain drafts; only a successful save establishes the saved shared state.

workflows.title: Login Portal branding
workflows.purpose: An Admin configures the existing sign-in branding and previews its appearance.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Login Portals.
rules: Login Portal configuration is Admin-only; it does not create or authenticate an account.
Saved portal branding is shared; personal sidebar title and logo remain separate in F08.
Preview and discard operations preserve existing drafts and upload limits.

workflows.title: Payment Methods configuration
workflows.purpose: An Admin controls the payment methods available to eligible new Customer product orders.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Payment Methods.

steps.label: Review cash and QR Ph readiness

rules: Payment availability is Admin-only and does not confirm, refund or rewrite existing payments.
Cash on pickup applies to eligible pickup orders; online readiness depends on the real provider configuration.
Disabling all methods can pause new product orders. Existing payments retain their recorded workflow.

workflows.title: Shipping, delivery and tracking settings
workflows.purpose: Configure delivery coverage, pricing, preparation periods and the current automatic-tracking connection.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Shipping & Delivery.

steps.label: Edit areas, fees and working days

rules: City choices follow Province; the explicit province-wide option preserves broad coverage.
Draft and published settings differ. New quotations use published values; accepted quotes are retained.
Tracking requires the configured 17TRACK account and J&T carrier verification; a preview is not a live delivery test.

workflows.title: Transaction Policy drafting and publication
workflows.purpose: Publish an approved version of transaction and refund terms for new Customer acceptance.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Transaction Policies.
rules: Admin publication creates a version; editing a draft alone does not replace the published policy.
An order retains its accepted terms/version rather than silently adopting later policy wording.
Publishing text does not override implemented payment, cancellation or refund guards.

workflows.title: Email Template customization
workflows.purpose: Customize permitted notification copy while preserving required transaction data and actual event triggers.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Email Templates.
rules: Email Templates are Admin-only. Template editing does not send a Customer transaction or approve its state.
Required tokens and protected transactional content retain their existing rules.
A successful save or preview is not proof of actual SMTP delivery.

workflows.title: Maintenance controls
workflows.purpose: An Admin applies existing Customer-facing maintenance scopes and page notices.
workflows.trigger: An Admin opens Maintenance.

steps.label: See maintenance notice or open page

rules: Maintenance settings are Admin-only and are enforced by existing request middleware, not only frontend visibility.
Customer scopes retain their current boundaries; Staff account applications are not blocked by Customer-site maintenance.
A preview is separate from saving the actual maintenance configuration.
